finding.before: The v0.3.1 core preserved opposing qualifying returns within one application, but a later applyHandoffResults call could erase a historical contest when no new receipt arrived or convert it into unilateral closure when one later directional receipt arrived.
finding.after: The contest-persistence guard preserves CONTESTED_BY_RECEIPTS across later applications. A matching unilateral late receipt is audited as HISTORICAL_CONTEST_PRESERVED and cannot close the branch until a future explicit adjudication mechanism exists. v0.3.8 adds lens-specific adequacy and bounded-null search handling without weakening conflict behavior.
